scientific_integrity: The proof uses the explicit unweighted upper-half-plane Bergman kernel, its mixed derivatives, and an exact quadratic discriminant. The embedded standard-library checker verifies the coefficients and samples, not the universal theorem. Self-review passed; no independent validation or mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only real coefficients of value, first and second ordinary derivative evaluations; only unweighted upper-half-plane Bergman space. Complex coefficients, higher jets, and different domains are not classified. Scalar zeros refer to z minus the complex conjugate of w, not pair counts.
title: A sharp three-jet zero-free cone for upper-half-plane Bergman Gram kernels
